The methods in this lecture are implemented in the open-source
[`serocalculator`](https://github.com/UCD-SERG/serocalculator) R package.

The rest of this section walks through the whole estimation pipeline on
**simulated** data, where the true incidence rate is known and the estimate
can be checked against it. @sec-validation then repeats the exercise across
many simulated populations at once.
